a.text: The Sud Aviation Caravelle entered into service, operating on domestic trunk routes.

b.text: Panair incorporated SUD SE-210 Caravelle 6-R jet aircraft for its main domestic and South American routes.

a.text: Panair started operating the Douglas DC-8-33 to Europe.

b.text: A Douglas DC-7C registration PP-PDO struck an 84m hill 2,7 km away from the runway and broke up during its final approach at Recife.
